metadata.description: 0 to 1 Labs Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: codex-pr-review
plugins.description: Review a pull request using a dual-family pipeline (OpenAI Codex + Claude Opus) with a cross-family grounded verifier and a deterministic lint/typecheck/test floor.

plugins.name: claude-code-prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: Wrap a prompt in <optimize>...</optimize> and it is rewritten into a sharper prompt by the same model your session is running. Hook-based (UserPromptSubmit).

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Expanded, anti-AI-slop fork of the stock frontend-design skill — distinctive, production-grade UI with sharper triggering, richer typographic/aesthetic direction, font-loading mechanics, a workflow, and a hard accessibility/responsive quality floor.

plugins.name: nanobanana
plugins.description: Generate and edit photorealistic images with perfect text rendering using Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image). Auto-enhances prompts and supports aspect ratio, resolution, and reference-image editing.

plugins.name: iac-diagram-generator
plugins.description: Analyzes Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, Docker Compose) and generates professional cloud architecture diagrams with Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image).

plugins.name: iac-security-scan
plugins.description: Scans Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) for security misconfigurations with a hybrid Checkov + Claude Opus engine, maps findings to NIST 800-53 / FedRAMP controls, and generates validated remediation IaC. SARIF/CI output, --fix with safety rails, --live verification. Pairs with iac-diagram-generator.

plugins.name: codex-dispatch
plugins.description: Route a prompt to OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.6 sol/luna/terra) via /codex and get a synthesized answer back — like delegating to a subagent. Supports read-only advisory mode and workspace-write execution.

plugins.name: memex
plugins.description: Context-aware documentation for Claude Code: a UserPromptSubmit hook that lexically retrieves and injects the most relevant doc sections under a token budget. Optional glossary pins; no keyword map required. OpenTelemetry-instrumented.

plugins.name: elevenlabs
plugins.description: Text-to-speech, speech-to-text (Scribe v2), and sound effects with the ElevenLabs API. Zero-dependency Python script, key from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, audio saved to disk. Adds a /say command and an auto-triggering skill.
